source: Thrown classes: MEASURED with the real @elevenlabs/elevenlabs-js 2.71.0 + stubbed fetch (.ziv/logs/stage-02/survey/probe-wire.mjs -> probe-wire.out, 2026-10-07); SDK errors/ElevenLabsError.js, errors/handleNonStatusCodeError.js, api/errors/UnprocessableEntityError, core/fetcher/Fetcher.js (abort branch). Error body envelope, types and codes: https://elevenlabs.io/docs/eleven-api/resources/errors (accessed 2026-10-07; the 422 list shape per https://elevenlabs.io/docs/api-reference/speech-to-text/convert). Bodies marked VERBATIM are copied from those pages; the others are COMPOSED in the documented envelope.

detail.message: The 'keyterms' parameter is only supported with the 'scribe_v2' model. You specified 'scribe_v1'.

expect.transient: coax isTransient() reads statusCode -> 408/409/429/5xx retried by retrying(); 400/401/402/403/404/422 not. Abort and timeout carry no statusCode -> not transient. NOTE: every rate_limit_error is 429, including quota-style ones; whether a quota/credits problem is 402 (not retried) or 429 is per the docs table above.
expect.abort: The SDK turns an abort into a plain ElevenLabsError without statusCode; coax's aborting() normalizes it to CoaxAbortError because signal.aborted is true.
expect.message: ElevenLabsError.message is 'Status code: N\nBody: <pretty JSON>' - the vendor's own detail.message is inside .body.detail.message.
